notes.title: New UPDATE is out now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch v1.1.0:[/h1]

[h2]Private match Game Mode[/h2]

Introduced private match Game Mode! You can play directly with your friends! But be careful because in the private matches the public points are not calculated and you can't fight for the relics. You can check statistics about the private matches in the Profile menupoint.

[previewyoutube=G6za-25ARxs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/b07f5eb5de06b1b8ca135c445b86e5b972938ec9.png[/img]

[h2]New visaul and sound effects[/h2]	

Added new visual and audio effects. Discover the special abilities with the new effects and enjoy the new game music provided by Vertex Studio!

[previewyoutube=eNiu6N7ufr4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/b824fabcb1173608bf6b1e2aa1adb45eaaa18f83.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/19521420628960b514d6c3e8fac74d464febe675.png[/img]

[h2]New Status indicator icons[/h2]

	- Added new status indicators so now you can control your units easier during the battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/d63c00dd00189b3c9d95816b95d9e77d575214ba.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Audio settings[/h2]

	- Improved Audio settings! You can control the volume of the game music an the sound effects and these settings will be saved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/307c001ceb8955e9d8fd392fd3fee0556c7ef4d6.png[/img]

[h2]Property changes and bug fixes[/h2]

	- Modified the luck and visibility properties for Minotaur, Goblin and La Ciguapa.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/53f4f5961a9999f5a972f30b584e018bd3a1cd32.png[/img]
	- Several little bug fixes...

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2 Added "The Puzzle" + unit property modifications
notes.notes:
Patch v1.0.2
[list]
[*] Gashadokuro's damage, defense and HP value has been set to a lower value.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/9b87b1d9e50a9cd5dfb01237a80013240da46ad7.png[/img]
[*] La Ciguapa's visibility value has been set to a higher value so it is easier to hit now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/4327bec3f3c741a088bbc2726b9905c8cb244106.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243542/9abf3cd072bd59f9030585c3f7bf43d1246a52e6.png[/img]

notes.title: Get the War Relics!
notes.notes:
After the first week - 5th of February - the top 3 players will recieve the relics. After that the relic holders have to play at least 5 matches in one day to keep the relic. If a relic holder loses a match than the winner will be the new relic holder.
